summary_en: On November 13, 2026, the board resolved to acquire up to 1,800,000 shares (0.46% of outstanding shares) at 2,799 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, with total acquisition cost capped at 5,038.2 million yen. All acquired shares will be cancelled on November 30, 2026.
summary_jp: 11月16日にToSTNeT-3で180万株（発行済株式数の0.46％）を2,799円で買い付ける。買付上限金額は50億3,820万円。11月30日に取得株式全て消却予定。
